DIVINE SHOOTING GAME

Choose your operator. Phone: left thumb moves, right thumb aims, hold FIRE to shoot. Push the left stick to the edge to sprint. Buttons: JUMP, SPRINT, CROUCH, ZOOM, KNIFE, NADE, SKILL, FACE. Auto-fire shoots when your crosshair is on an enemy. If it lags, choose Low graphics below.
